requirements.evidence: CallNextTicket.php:56-63 locks the queue row and reads is_active from the DB (req. 5); :120-135 builds waiting-only, queue-scoped ordering priority desc -> issued_at asc -> id asc and the priority>0 / priority=0 mode filters (req. 1-3); :141-163 implements the last-3-called fairness with called_at desc, id desc and the 'a normal is waiting' guard (req. 4); :94-110 locks the candidate and re-checks it is still Waiting, skipping and looping otherwise (req. 7); :105-110 sets status/called_at/called_by_user_id and returns the saved model (req. 8); CallMode.php:5-9 and NoWaitingTicketsException.php:7-9 match the contract exactly, and docs/architecture.md:201-256 plus docs/business-rules.md:279-311 document the implementation (req. 9).

conventions.evidence: Domain write lives in app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php as an invokable action (conventions.md:42-45); docs kept in sync in the same change (docs/business-rules.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/database-schema.md:325) and CHANGELOG.md:9 under Added; public __invoke has a PHPDoc block (CallNextTicket.php:41-48); Pest tests ship with the behavior (conventions.md:12-18); no migration, service or repository layer added; style (final-ish small methods, imports, docblocks) matches the described sibling action pattern.

security.evidence: No user input or output in this change; all queries use bound parameters (CallNextTicket.php:122-134) and the actor is taken from the passed User (:107), which the task declares trusted/out of scope; no mass assignment (direct attribute writes at :105-108) so the ticket write-once rule holds; no unescaped output, no secrets, no Livewire surface added.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php covers ordering and id tie-break (:373-400), queue isolation and already-called exclusion (:402-418), returned model state (:420-437), both restricted modes (:439-465), inactive and stale queue (:467-492), all no-eligible-mode paths (:494-511), fairness incl. mode counting, streak reset, no-normal fallback, called_at/id history, other-queue isolation (:513-644), and the exactly-once skip/fallback paths (:646-712); assertions check the untouched tickets stay Waiting.

simplicity.evidence: Lean overall (one action, two small helpers, FAIRNESS_STREAK constant at CallNextTicket.php:39), but CallNextTicket.php:80-84 adds a fallback re-query that is unreachable: fairnessApplies() (:158-162) only returns true when a waiting normal exists, and the restricted query (:126-128) selects exactly that ticket unless it is in $skipped, which implies it is no longer waiting; the branch therefore duplicates the main selection for no reachable state and brings a dedicated test with it (tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php:646-679).

readability.evidence: Clear names (restrictToNormal, candidateQuery, fairnessApplies), short methods with explanatory comments (CallNextTicket.php:66-84, :92-103), docblocks on both helpers, and a readable test file with one scenario per test; only a cosmetic nit in the ASCII diagram at docs/architecture.md:229-231 where the nested arrows are mis-indented.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task: the action, enum, exception, three docs (business-rules/architecture required, database-schema write-once correction is a directly related consistency fix), CHANGELOG, and one test file; no unrelated refactors or features (no HTTP/Livewire/authorization added).

issues.explanation: The 'restricted candidate is null -> retry with full ordering' fallback is unreachable because fairnessApplies() has already verified a waiting normal exists for this queue, so the restricted query can only miss it if it is in $skipped (i.e. no longer waiting), making this extra branch dead code.

This test exercises the unreachable fallback path: the concurrent ticket is already called, so the second loop iteration re-evaluates fairness (streak reset by the normal call) and takes the normal full-ordering path, meaning the fallback branch itself is never covered.
The test is named 'counts calls made in priority_only and normal_only modes in the fairness history' but only a PriorityOnly call is made; the normal_only half of the title is not exercised.
The two nested arrow lines are indented differently from the rest of the ASCII diagram, breaking its vertical alignment.

A queue row deleted between construction and invocation fails with ModelNotFoundException from firstOrFail() rather than a domain exception; the task does not specify this case, so this is a minor consistency observation only.

review.summary: The change adds the invokable CallNextTicket action, CallMode enum and NoWaitingTicketsException, implementing deterministic ordering, the three call modes, the 3-consecutive-priority fairness rule, inactive-queue rejection with a locked DB re-read, and exactly-once marking with a ticket-row re-check, plus docs and a broad Pest suite. Requirements, conventions, security and tests are all met; the overall score is 4 (approve with nits) because of an unreachable fallback branch in the selection loop and a test whose title/behavior drift, with the remaining findings cosmetic. Confidence is medium because the Ticket model casts, Ticket::factory() states and InactiveQueueException constructor used by the action/tests are outside the diff and could not be verified.
